vulnerability.name: USN-7868-1
vulnerability.description: Hanno Böck discovered that Raptor incorrectly handled memory operations when processing certain input files. An attacker could use this issue to cause Raptor to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2017-18926)  Hanno Böck discovered that Raptor incorrectly handled memory operations when processing certain input files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Raptor to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2020-25713)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in Raptor. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
